recommendations.evidence: Existing base patient support[2] covers steroid/hormone management; CRC support[1] already prohibits self-restart. Monitoring only says clinical review. KB key_points[1] says specific restart criteria but does not explain confirmations.
recommendations.patient_amendment: If treatment is paused because of an immune side effect, your team checks recovery and any steroid or hormone plan before deciding whether it can restart. Do not change steroids or restart treatment yourself.
recommendations.clinician_amendment: Requested restart needs documented source-specific recovery, required steroid management/taper and consultant confirmation. Table 1 endocrine exceptions remain separate; existing 12-week failure/taper and permanent-stop criteria retain priority.
recommendations.source: NCCP 00455 v16 / 00558 v13 pp5–6, Table1 and dose modifications
recommendations.regenerate: Carry approved text into affected portal/passport, knowledge/support output and printable handbook. Existing anatomy, schedule and risks need no reduction.

recommendations.evidence: Patient support[2] covers steroids and hormone replacement but not the difference between replacement and immunosuppression. Existing clinician profiles[0:2] key_points omit symptom-conditioned thyroid/pituitary decisions.
recommendations.patient_amendment: Hormone replacement alone does not always mean nivolumab must stop. Your team checks symptoms and recovery and reviews any medicines that suppress the immune system before deciding whether treatment can continue or restart.
recommendations.clinician_amendment: Symptomatic grade 2–3 hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism or hypophysitis requires holding; missing symptom status requires review, not a normal assumption. Controlled asymptomatic replacement does not by itself require a hold. Grade4 endocrine and other permanent-stop rules still apply. Do not restart while another immunosuppressive therapy is being given.
recommendations.source: NCCP 00483 / 00484 v13a p6 and p7 Table3
recommendations.regenerate: Update support/monitoring wording, portal/passport/KB and relevant printable handbook section; retain anatomy and grade4 risks.

recommendations.evidence: Patient schedule/chapter explains the first maintenance dose and permitted colorectal formulations but no later interval switch. Urgent text already says spreading/blistering rash needs immediate oncology contact; support already prohibits self-restart.
recommendations.patient_amendment: If the team changes the interval between nivolumab-only doses, they will give you a new appointment plan: the first four-weekly dose is two weeks after the last two-weekly dose, or the first two-weekly dose is four weeks after the last four-weekly dose. Do not change the schedule yourself.
recommendations.clinician_amendment: Established maintenance q14→q28 first dose is 14 days after last q14 dose; q28→q14 first dose is 28 days after last q28 dose. This is separate from initial post-combination timing and does not authorise IV480 in CRC. Symptoms/signs suggesting SJS/TEN require cessation and urgent specialised assessment before confirmation; confirmed SJS/TEN requires permanent discontinuation.
recommendations.source: NCCP 00551 v7a p2 switching; p9 skin toxicity
recommendations.regenerate: Append interval explanation to schedule/logistics chapter without changing CRC induction or first-maintenance text. Existing patient blistering-rash immediate-contact wording is already aligned; add explicit suspected/confirmed distinction to clinician KB/support. Regenerate affected output/PDF sections.
